checks.invariant: An owner may only read/modify objects belonging to their own store; foreign ids must 404, never leak or mutate.
checks.result: PASS. CatalogBaseViewSet.my_store() resolves Store via get_object_or_404(Store, user__user=request.user) (viewset_base.py:21-25) and every queryset factory filters store=view.my_store() (viewset_config.py:28-41); get_object() therefore 404s cross-tenant ids on list/retrieve/update/destroy/custom actions. ServicesBaseViewSet and StoreBaseViewSet mirror the pattern. Store-scoped deletes use get_object_or_404(Model, pk=image_id, store=store) (viewset.py:1857,1917) and version restore filters StudioVersion by pk+store (viewset.py:1677).

checks.invariant: Client input must not mass-assign store FKs, is_blocked, plan/subscription fields, prices bypassing validators, or other privileged columns.
checks.result: PASS. create() forces serializer.save(store=self.my_store()); 'store' absent from every write serializer's fields. StoreSerializer exposes only id/user(HiddenField)/slug/is_published — is_blocked/blocked_* not writable; StoreCreateMixin enforces one store per profile. StoreCustomizationSerializer fields list contains no store FK and marks computed fields read-only. Product/Service/Discount write serializers validate category/brand/product ownership against context['store'].

checks.invariant: Plan/benefit gates must be enforced on every owner verb and custom action, fail-closed on downgrade.
checks.result: PASS with one exception (candidate 1). CatalogGateMixin gates create/update/destroy via catalog_enabled=has_public_link; DiscountViewSet gates all verbs via has_discounts; ReviewViewSet gates list/destroy/reply via store_has_reviews and returns 405 for update/partial_update; ServiceViewSet gates all verbs + order via services_enabled=has_services_site with SERVICES_MAX=24. Stores actions gate per-benefit (has_customization, has_ai_design, has_custom_domain, has_stats, has_chatbot). Customization PATCH drops disallowed premium fields server-side and whitelists template/template_draft. EXCEPTION: published layout_config is not re-filtered on the public read path — see candidate catalog-owner:layout-config-plan-gate-read-drift.

checks.invariant: Quota checks (max_products, SERVICES_MAX, image caps) must be race-safe and rechecked under lock.
checks.result: PASS for products/services/images. Product create rechecks can_add_product under select_for_update on the store row inside transaction.atomic. Service create does the same with SERVICES_MAX. upload_carousel_image caps at CAROUSEL_MAX_IMAGES=5 and upload_gallery_image enforces plan max_gallery_images + DECOR_MAX_IMAGES + has_design_advanced for decor, each rechecked under select_for_update. bulk_update_prices/import_prices operate on store-scoped querysets only. GAP: categories, brands and discounts have no count quota at all — see candidate catalog-owner:uncapped-taxonomy-discount-public-cost.

checks.invariant: Discounts must not allow invalid percentages, foreign scope targets, inverted/overlapping windows, negative effective prices, or scope inconsistencies.
checks.result: PASS. DiscountLimits percent_min=1/percent_max=99 with serializer min/max and DB check; DiscountMixinValidator.validate requires category/brand/products targets to belong to context store, caps products scope at 500, enforces ends_at>starts_at, and excludes overlapping products-scope discounts. Public effective pricing takes min(manual offer, best discount) only when below list price — no negative/zero-price abuse. running_discounts_of fails closed without has_discounts.

checks.invariant: Review moderation must stay inside the owner's store; owners must not create/edit reviews through this endpoint.
checks.result: PASS. _own_reviews filters ProductReview by store=my_store(); ReviewViewSet.update/partial_update return 405; reply action resolves via get_object() on the scoped queryset and only writes owner_reply via ReviewReplySerializer; create is not routed (public creation lives under product_reviews with customer auth).

checks.invariant: Image order/remove actions must only touch the caller's store images; unknown/foreign ids ignored or 404.
checks.result: PASS. carousel_order/gallery_order call _apply_order on store-scoped querysets so foreign/duplicate ids are skipped; carousel_remove/gallery_remove use get_object_or_404(Model, pk=image_id, store=store). Uploads enforce plan caps under lock.

checks.invariant: Customization PATCH must drop plan-gated fields server-side and sanitize layout_config/site_theme/template against the current plan.
checks.result: PASS on the write path. The PATCH handler pops DESIGN_ADVANCED/LOCATION/REVIEW/LIVE_STREAM/SITE_THEME fields and ecommerce_enabled-enable without the benefit, and whitelists template/template_draft via allowed_templates_of. StoreCustomizationSerializer.validate_layout_config/_draft run clean_layout_config(value, has_advanced, has_ai) which drops unknown/duplicate/premium/ai_only blocks and sanitizes variants/props; _clean_theme runs clean_site_theme with plan flags. Publish re-checks template_draft against allowed_templates_of — but copies layout_config/site_theme drafts verbatim, and the public serializer does not re-filter layout_config: see candidate 1.

checks.invariant: Public catalog filters/sorts must be allowlisted; bulk price/import scopes must stay inside the owner's store.
checks.result: PASS. CATALOG_SORTS is a closed map; ?category/?brand ids capped at CATALOG_IDS_MAX=50 via _id_list; ?features= bounded to 10 groups/15 values/4096 bytes; ?q= truncated to 80 chars; min/max price clamped to field max. bulk_update_prices and import_prices build Product.objects.filter(store=store) first and narrow within it — foreign product/category/brand ids are silently ignored. Minor robustness gap: non-numeric category/brand/product_ids reach filter(pk=...) and raise ValueError->500 (see hardening).

checks.invariant: Store update must be owner-scoped with no privileged-field mass assignment; staff moderation endpoints must be admin-only.
checks.result: PASS. update queryset = Store.objects.filter(user__user=request.user) so foreign pk->404; non-staff list/retrieve limited to own store, staff sees all. StoreSerializer writable fields are slug+is_published only; slug validated for format/RESERVED_SLUGS/uniqueness excluding self. block/unblock require IsAdminUser; web_quality enforces owner-or-staff with explicit 403; domain actions are owner-scoped + has_custom_domain; stats scoped via profile.store + has_stats; chatbot GET open to owner, PATCH gated has_chatbot.

checks.invariant: Plan-gated customization data must be re-filtered on the PUBLIC read path, not only at write time (same policy as site_theme/videos/live_stream/site_templates).
checks.result: FAIL -> candidate catalog-owner:layout-config-plan-gate-read-drift. StoreCustomizationPublicSerializer.to_representation re-filters site_theme (filter_site_theme), videos cap, live_stream_url, site_templates/show_catalog, accent fields and review toggles but serves layout_config verbatim; publish (viewset.py:1599) and restore (1680-1684) copy draft/snapshot layout_config without re-running clean_layout_config; the Vue BlockRenderer mounts saved ai_* blocks with registered components and no benefit check.

checks.invariant: Owner-writable collections that feed shared public payloads must be bounded like products/services/images.
checks.result: FAIL -> candidate catalog-owner:uncapped-taxonomy-discount-public-cost. Category/Brand viewsets gate only on catalog_enabled (has_public_link — cheapest plan) and DiscountViewSet only on has_discounts; none cap row count. Every public catalog request runs running_discount_stamp (viewset.py:1028; services.py:67-91 = query + Python loop over all in-window discounts) even on cache hit; on miss it computes effective_pricing_of per product x discount (1131-1142), serializes ALL categories/brands including empty ones (1194-1195,1233-1234) and all running discounts as promotions (1231-1235).

checks.invariant: Studio share-preview tokens must be unforgeable, store-bound, expiring, and must not leak other tenants' drafts.
checks.result: PASS. customization_share signs {'s': store.pk} with TimestampSigner+salt and PREVIEW_SHARE_TTL=3d; _preview_ok unsigns with max_age and requires data['s']==store.pk; preview swaps draft fields in-memory only, is no-store, skips visit counting. Invalid/foreign token degrades to normal published view.

candidates.title: Published layout_config bypasses the plan gate on the public read path: AI-only blocks keep rendering after downgrade
candidates.description: layout_config blocks flagged ai_only (aiquote, aistrip, aicheck, aigrid, aiband, aipricing, aiprocess, aimosaic — gated by has_ai_design) and premium (banner — gated by has_design_advanced) are stripped only when the config is WRITTEN (clean_layout_config via serializer validation or the AI-design apply path). The published value is then served verbatim by StoreCustomizationPublicSerializer and the Vue BlockRenderer mounts any saved block id that has a registered component — there is no benefit check on the read/render path. Every sibling plan-gated field IS re-filtered in the same serializer's to_representation (site_theme via filter_site_theme, videos cap, live_stream_url blanked, site_templates/show_catalog effective, accent fields reset, review toggles) — layout_config was missed. Net effect: a store that used 'Disenar con IA' or Studio publish/restore while on a plan with has_ai_design keeps those AI content blocks live on its public site after downgrading to a plan without the benefit, indefinitely, until the owner republishes a cleaned layout. The frontend's own comment acknowledges the gap but wrongly assumes 'sin props no pintan nada' — the ai_* blocks carry sanitized props (text, items, captions) written by the AI engine, and BlkAi* components render them (e.g., BlkAiQuote.vue renders block.props.text). The premium 'banner' catalog block is NOT exploitable (no BlkBanner component is registered, so it never mounts).
candidates.root_cause: Plan enforcement for layout blocks exists only in the write-path sanitizer (clean_layout_config). The public serializer trusts the stored published layout_config and the frontend renderer trusts the payload; unlike site_theme there is no read-side effective-value computation for layout_config.
candidates.intended_behavior: The effective public layout should reflect the CURRENT plan — the same policy the codebase already applies to site_theme (filter_site_theme), template (allowed_templates re-check at publish and resolveStoreTemplate at render), videos, live_stream_url, site_templates and accent fields.

trace.description: _clean_blocks drops premium blocks without has_advanced and ai_only blocks without has_ai — but this runs only inside clean_layout_config at write/validate time.
validate_layout_config / validate_layout_config_draft call clean_layout_config with the plan flags current at PATCH time.
customization_publish copies layout_config_draft -> layout_config verbatim; template_draft is re-checked against allowed_templates_of (line 1604) but layout_config is not re-cleaned.
customization_restore copies the StudioVersion snapshot's layout_config into both published and draft fields verbatim (no re-clean); template is re-checked at 1694.

StoreCustomizationPublicSerializer.to_representation re-filters site_theme (724), videos (714-717), live_stream_url (718-719), site_templates/show_catalog (733-736), accent fields (707-709) and review toggles (702-704) — layout_config is absent and served unfiltered.
blocks computed inserts saved layout_config blocks not present in the template's canonical layout whenever props.components[raw.id] exists — no plan/benefit check (lines 41-53).
landingExtras registers all eight ai_* block components (aiquote…aimosaic) for every landing view, so props.components[raw.id] resolves for them on the public site.
aiOnly blocks documented; comment claims 'el render publico no los filtra (sin props no pintan nada)' — incorrect: ai_* props are stored and rendered (BlkAiQuote.vue renders block.props.text/author).
has_ai_design=False on Plan basico (and has_design_advanced=False at line 62): plan-differentiated paid benefits, so post-downgrade persistence is an entitlement leak.

candidates.evidence: Full source chain verified: write-time-only gate (layout_blocks.py:294-297) -> verbatim publish/restore (viewset.py:1599,1680-1684) -> unfiltered public serialization (serializers.py:696-737) -> unconditional frontend mount of saved ai_* extras (BlockRenderer.vue:36-58 + _shared.js:104-112). No runtime test performed (source-only audit).
candidates.conditions: Store must have layout_config containing ai_* blocks (via ai-design/apply or Studio publish) written while on a plan with has_ai_design, then downgrade (or draft a premium layout, downgrade, then publish — publish copies the draft verbatim). Applies to the landing surface.

payloads: downgrade subscription to plan without has_ai_design
execution.observed_result: customization.layout_config in the public payload still contains the aiquote block; the public landing renders BlkAiQuote with its stored props despite the plan lacking has_ai_design.

candidates.remediation: Re-filter layout_config on the public read path: in StoreCustomizationPublicSerializer.to_representation, run the stored layout_config through a read-side variant of clean_layout_config (or a dedicated filter that drops ai_only blocks without has_ai_design and premium blocks without has_design_advanced) before returning it — mirroring filter_site_theme. Defense in depth: also re-run clean_layout_config/clean_site_theme inside customization_publish and customization_restore before save, the same way template_draft is re-checked against allowed_templates_of at viewset.py:1604/1694.

severity.rationale: Requires a plan downgrade after using AI design/Studio; leaked content is the store's own sanitized marketing copy (no cross-tenant data, no code execution — props are strip_tags-cleaned and length-capped). Impact is continued use of a paid-tier feature (entitlement/revenue leak), consistent with how the codebase treats other downgraded benefits.

candidates.title: No quota on categories, brands or discounts lets an owner amplify public catalog request cost without bound
candidates.description: Product creation is plan-capped (max_products rechecked under select_for_update) and services are capped (SERVICES_MAX=24 under lock), but Category, Brand and Discount creation have only plan-flag gates — catalog_enabled (has_public_link, available on the cheapest plan) and has_discounts — with no count limit anywhere in the viewsets, serializers or models. These unbounded collections feed the anonymous public catalog endpoint /api/stores/public/<slug>/catalog/: running_discount_stamp(store) is evaluated on EVERY request (cache hit or miss) as part of the cache key — one query plus a Python loop over all in-window discounts calling campaign.is_running() per row (services.py:67-91). On cache miss, _public_catalog_data additionally runs effective_pricing_of per product x per running discount (O(PxD) via discount_covers, viewset.py:1131-1142), serializes ALL categories and brands — including empty ones (viewset.py:1194-1195,1233-1234) — and all running discounts as promotions (1231-1235). An owner can create thousands of taxonomy rows/discounts via repeated POSTs, inflating per-request CPU/DB work and response payload size for every anonymous visitor of that store and for shared worker/cache capacity. Discount creation also fires _broadcast_offer -> notify_store_discount to all store members per create (viewset.py:165-177), so mass creation additionally spams the owner's own customers.
candidates.root_cause: Resource quotas were applied to products, services and images but never to catalog taxonomy (categories, brands) or discounts, even though all of them are serialized into the shared public catalog payload on every cache miss and discounts are scanned on every request via the cache-key stamp.
candidates.intended_behavior: Owner-writable collections that feed shared public payloads should be bounded — per-plan benefit limits or fixed ceilings enforced under select_for_update, the same pattern used for max_products, SERVICES_MAX and the image caps.

trace.description: CategoryViewSet/BrandViewSet inherit only CatalogGateMixin (catalog_enabled=has_public_link); no count check on create.
DiscountViewSet gates on has_discounts flag only; no count check on create (lines 147-153).
public_catalog builds cache_key with running_discount_stamp(store) on every request, before cache_get — cost paid even on hits.
running_discount_stamp runs a query over all active in-window discounts and a Python sorted() loop with campaign.is_running() per row — O(active discounts) per anonymous request.
On cache miss: running_discounts_of + per-product effective_pricing_of -> winning_discount_of -> discount_covers iterates every running discount per product — O(products x discounts).
categories/brands fetched unfiltered (no products_count>0 filter) and fully serialized at 1233-1234; all running discounts serialized as promotions at 1231-1235.
Products DO enforce max_products under select_for_update — proving the intended quota pattern that taxonomy/discounts lack.
has_public_link=True on Plan basico — the cheapest paid plan suffices to create unbounded categories/brands.

candidates.evidence: Missing caps are directly visible: no count validation in CategoryViewSet/BrandViewSet/DiscountViewSet create paths, serializers or models (uniqueness is per-(store,name), so distinct names are unbounded). Cost path fully traced in source. PUBLIC_CACHE_TTL=120s and PublicReadThrottle bound but do not eliminate the amplification.
candidates.conditions: Authenticated owner with an active plan (has_public_link for categories/brands; has_discounts for discounts) running a sustained create loop; public catalog traffic on that store.

execution.observed_result: Each anonymous catalog request executes running_discount_stamp over all in-window discounts; each cache miss serializes the entire (unbounded) taxonomy and promotions and runs O(PxD) pricing. Payload size and per-request CPU grow linearly with owner-created rows.

candidates.remediation: Add count quotas for categories, brands and discounts — either new plan benefits (e.g., max_categories/max_brands/max_discounts) or fixed ceilings like SERVICES_MAX — enforced in create under select_for_update on the store row (mirroring can_add_product/can_add_service). Additionally: exclude categories/brands with products_count=0 from the public payload (or cap the serialized lists), cap the promotions list length, and consider folding the discount stamp into the cached payload version instead of recomputing per request.

severity.rationale: Requires deliberate abuse by a paying tenant; PublicReadThrottle and the 120s payload cache bound the rate, but the per-request stamp and unbounded miss-path work are real shared-infrastructure amplification. Payload can grow to megabytes with tens of thousands of taxonomy rows.

hardening: bulk_prices: coerce/validate category, brand and product_ids to integers before use — non-numeric values currently reach store.categories.filter(pk='abc')/id__in and raise ValueError -> HTTP 500 (viewset.py:375-390; price_updates.py:84-88). Same class of issue for oversized product_ids lists (unbounded id__in).

customization_publish and customization_restore copy layout_config/site_theme drafts/snapshots verbatim; even after adding a read-side layout_config filter, re-running clean_layout_config/clean_site_theme at publish/restore (like the template_draft whitelist check at viewset.py:1604/1694) would keep stored drafts honest and shrink the downgrade window.

DiscountViewSet._broadcast_offer fires notify_store_discount to all store members on every create/activate (viewset.py:165-177); a mass-create loop spams the owner's own customers — consider dedupe/throttle on the notification path.

Category/Brand/Discount list endpoints return the full unpaginated queryset (CatalogBaseViewSet.list has no pagination); harmless for the owner but compounds candidate 2 — cap or paginate once quotas exist.
StoreSerializer.is_published is owner-writable; acceptable because public endpoints independently enforce has_public_link, but consider gating publish on an active subscription for defense in depth.
export_prices iterates the entire product queryset per request (plan-capped, so bounded) — fine today; revisit if max_products becomes unlimited on the top tier.
uncovered: AdminApp domains (users, suscriptions, payments, invoices, legal) — outside this unit.
StoreApp domains orders, customers, feed, memberships, shipping/payment config, support chat — other coverage units.
design domain internals beyond layout/theme gating (sanitize_markup, pattern document CSP/bridge) — reviewed only at the layout_config boundary; full pattern-render audit not repeated here.
Project settings: throttle rate values, CORS/CSRF, middleware ordering, SECURE_* flags — not audited in this unit.
Celery tasks and Django signals (e.g., bump_public_store cache invalidation correctness) — referenced but not audited.

Frontend per-component XSS review of Blk* props rendering — backend sanitizes props (strip_tags + length caps) and Vue escapes interpolations, but individual block components were not exhaustively audited.
Runtime/deployment facts (throttle effectiveness under real traffic, DB constraint behavior, R2 public-URL configuration) — source-only audit.
